units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:25">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כד מְנַפְּיָיא וכ׳</he> when she fans (blows the chaff out, on the Sabbath), she is guilty of an act coming under the category of winnowing.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite> [read:] <he>אזל נַפְּיָיהּ והיא וכ׳</he> go and winnow it (again), and it will yield the remainder; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 604:10">Yalk. ib. 604</cite> <he>זיל נַפֵּי תיבנא וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="K01007"><he>כפי</he></cite>).
